title: Design and implement incident-safe emergency admin playbook (break-glass v2)
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Create a formal, auditable, and automatable emergency admin (break-glass) playbook that integrates RBAC v2, audit logging, and SSO/SAML controls. This ticket covers policy design, short-lived credentials & approval flow, telemetry hooks, and runbook authoring. The playbook must support both Hosted and Dedicated/Admin Console workflows, and be compatible with Private deployments (VPC).
acceptance_criteria: A well-documented playbook (Confluence) with step-by-step runbook for common emergency scenarios (control-plane outage, key compromise, customer SLA incident)
Implementation of time-limited break-glass tokens (max 2 hours) with automatic revocation and mandatory justification recorded in audit logs
Approval flow implemented: either 2-step automated approval (oncall + security) or fallback to time-limited one-click break-glass when paged agent is unreachable
RBAC v2 policy changes to grant a narrowly-scoped emergency_admin role and no persistent elevation paths
Audit events emitted for every break-glass action: actor, justification, token id, scope, start/end timestamps, affected resources
E2E simulation test that demonstrates token issuance, use, and revocation with simulated SSO/SAML provider and logs shipped to Audit Pipeline
Security review completed and signed-off by Head of Security and Legal where required
runbook_steps: Trigger conditions - define when break-glass applies (e.g., control plane unavailable, urgent rollback)
Initial escalation - page primary oncall and post incident channel with intended scope
Attempt standard escalation via SSO-based emergency channel (Okta SAML step-up)
If SSO unreachable - issue ephemeral emergency token via automated breaker service with strict TTL
Automated approval step: check primary oncall and security approver presence; if both absent, create an audit-only emergency token with shorter TTL and notify execs
Perform mitigation under 'emergency_admin' role only; avoid credential export or root-level access unless explicitly noted
Close loop: revoke token immediately after action, attach justification and links to PR/commands to the audit entry
Post-incident review: create retro ticket, rotate any secrets touched, update RBAC policies and add derived policy exceptions if needed
implementation_notes: Ephemeral token service will be an extension of existing auth service with new endpoint POST /auth/v1/emergency-tokens
Tokens must be cryptographically bound to session and auditable — store hashed token IDs in audit DB, not raw tokens
Integrate with existing audit pipeline (Kafka -> ClickHouse) and add break_glass event type with schema version 2
When possible use SAML step-up (Okta) to record SSO assertion id in audit logs to tie actions back to identity provider
For Dedicated and Private: provide a disabled-by-default operator API that allows on-prem operators to enable break-glass with enterprise policy checks
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Break-glass tokens abused - Mitigation: very short TTL, mandatory justification, two independent approvers when available
Risk: Audit logs tampered in private installs - Mitigation: append-only log storage recommendation (WORM), default log signing, and guidance in deployment docs
Risk: SSO outage prevents normal approvals - Mitigation: pre-configured offline approval path with stricter constraints and exec notification
testing_plan: Unit tests for token issuance and revocation logic
Integration tests simulating SAML/Okta step-up and fallback path
Chaos test: simulate control-plane outage and verify break-glass flow still allows safe recovery without persistent elevation
Audit verification: compare emitted audit events against schema and ensure events surface in Console timeline and alerts
tasks: Define emergency_admin RBAC role and minimal privileges (ENG-8433)
Implement ephemeral token API and TTL enforcement (ENG-8440)
Add audit schema and pipeline consumer updates (ENG-8451)
Write Confluence playbook and attach runbook snippets
Schedule security review and tabletop exercise
